name: SharePoint/OneDrive — Burst of Anonymous Sharing Links by a User
description:
Attacker objective
Expose or exfiltrate sensitive documents by creating many anonymous ('anyone with the link') sharing links, which require no authentication to access.

Attack logic
Anonymous links bypass tenant access controls. A user creating them in bulk within a short window is mass-exposing data, whether as a malicious insider or a compromised account.

Why this detection works
The unified audit log records anonymous-link creation per user; a per-user burst distinguishes mass exposure from the routine single-link sharing that makes per-event alerting unusable.

False positives
A user legitimately publishing many documents for external collaboration.

Tuning
Set the per-user burst threshold above the routine sharing rate; allowlist sanctioned external-collaboration accounts; review the shared sites/files.

Required telemetry
o365.audit RecordType 14 / SharePointSharing, Operation 'AnonymousLinkCreated' (SiteUrl, user.name).
author: raadabujaish
note:
## Investigation guide
1. Review the sites/files the user shared anonymously and whether they are sensitive.
2. Confirm business justification; if none, revoke the links and investigate the account for compromise or insider data theft.
false_positives: A user legitimately publishing many documents for external collaboration.
